definitions.explanation: Having no flaws, defects, or shortcomings. Most commonly encountered in the four-character compound {完全|かんぜん}{無欠|むけつ} (absolute perfection).

examples.japanese: ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no such thing as a flawless plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He is not a flawless human being.

examples.japanese: ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャリア→キャリア：10821_kyaria⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Behind her career that appeared absolutely flawless, there were actually many struggles.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without, lacking) and {欠|けつ} (defect, lack). Almost always used in the four-character compound ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ} (kanzen muketsu), meaning 'absolute perfection' or 'flawless.' On its own, {無欠|むけつ} is rarely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ}: absolutely flawless, perfect in every way
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a flawless person
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a flawless work

USAGE:
The phrase ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ} is often used with irony or in the negative, since true perfection is considered impossible. Saying something is ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{無欠|むけつ} can sound overly idealized.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧: perfect, flawless — the most common everyday word for 'perfect'
- {申|もう}し{分|ぶん}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: flawless, beyond reproach — a polite expression meaning there is nothing to criticize
- ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ちどころ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: beyond reproach — an idiomatic expression meaning there are no faults to point out
